structural_issues: Inconsistent heading hierarchy: Uses '## 1.', '## 2.', '## 3.' then jumps to '### 4.' and '## **The plugins' - no clear section numbering scheme
Informal language throughout: 'THE TWO-ALWAYS-LOADED-PLUGINS', 'pretty much', 'these are just a few as I thought of', 'this is not enough', ' ultrathink for this matter'
Missing frontmatter: No title metadata, author, version, status, or date - violates BMAD artifact standards
Incomplete lists with 'etc.': Lines 22, 29, 40 use 'and so many more', 'etc.', 'and so on' - vague requirements
No table of contents or navigation: 163-line document with no TOC, making it hard to navigate
Mixed language styles: Contains informal bullet points alongside markdown code blocks, inconsistent with technical documentation standards
Line 149 references non-existent file 'fundamental-truth-check-list.md' - broken internal reference

alignment_violations.claim: Routes mention '/ide/$projectId' and '/notes/$projectId' as active routes (lines 11, 29, 33-34, 38-39, 50, 61, 127-130)
alignment_violations.issue: Amendment 001 explicitly ELIMINATES workspace-centric routes. Lines 208-211 state: 'No more `?layout=ide` or `?layout=notes` query params' and 'All navigation uses /$projectId (not /ide/$projectId or /notes/$projectId)'. Old routes are deprecated and should redirect to /$projectId without layout params

Amendment 001 lines 387-390 explicitly states: 'This eliminates: The concept of "workspaces" (IDE, Notes, etc.)'. The mental model should be 'User picks a project, platform determines available tools' - NOT workspace-centric

alignment_violations.claim: Lines 59-60 mention '2-always-loaded-plugins' with file-tree/project management + agent chat
alignment_violations.issue: ADR-034 defines specific feature plugins (lines 85-103): 'filetree', 'monaco', 'notes', 'terminal', 'chat', 'agents'. The document doesn't map to these exact PluginId values, creating potential misalignment

alignment_violations.claim: Line 149: 'Multiple projects across workspaces (IDE, Notes - Knowledge/Study disabled for MVP)'
alignment_violations.issue: Uses deprecated 'workspaces' terminology. Should be 'Multiple projects with platform-filtered features' since Knowledge/Study plugins are disabled for MVP

inaccuracies.claim: Line 5: 'GPT 5.2 variants' and 'Claude 4.5' - references non-existent model versions
inaccuracies.issue: As of 2026-01-25, these model versions don't exist. GPT-5 is not released, Claude 4.5 is speculative. Should verify with official provider documentation before claiming support

inaccuracies.claim: Lines 147-148: 'Use Tanstack AI SDK & Tanstack Start' + 'Keys persisted in vault'
inaccuracies.issue: AGENTS.md (line 705) lists AI as 'Google Gemini (via @tanstack/ai-gemini)' - but document claims Tanstack Start for BYOK vault which may not align with current implementation

inaccuracies.claim: Line 160: 'Clearly define and connect Zustand (client state) and Dexie (persisted data) usage'
inaccuracies.issue: Vague - doesn't reference existing ADR-033 store architecture decisions (StorageGateway, PlatformContract interfaces) which already define these boundaries

missing_sections: No API contracts defined for plugins: ADR-034 defines FeaturePlugin interface (lines 84-103) but document doesn't reference or elaborate on required API contracts
No error handling patterns: Critical topics like DexieDB quota handling, FSA permission failures, offline-first fallbacks are mentioned as concerns but not addressed
No sync strategy defined: Line 18 mentions 'synchronization' concerns for large projects but no concrete sync strategy is provided
No state management boundary specification: Line 20 mentions Zustand/Dexie conflicts but no resolution pattern is defined
No CRUD permission matrix: Lines 14-15, 54, 122 mention agent permissions but no concrete permission schema is provided
No RAG indexing strategy: Document mentions RAG features but provides no implementation approach for local RAG vectors
No mobile/tablet UX specification: Mentions 'portrait phone screen' but no concrete responsive layout patterns for plugins on small screens

ADR-034-AMENDMENT-001 eliminates workspace concept. Should use 'project' for the entity, and describe features as 'platform-filtered' or 'platform-appropriate'
